instruction: Show me how to open the Gaussian Blur filter dialog.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Gaussian Blur filter window in GIMP. The evaluator checks GIMP's action-history file for the 'filters-gaussian-blur' action. Gaussian Blur is one of the most commonly used filters in GIMP.
metadata.verification: Verified that GIMP's action-history tracks blur filter usage. Gaussian Blur is accessed via Filters > Blur > Gaussian Blur, matching the pattern of the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to display the Gaussian Blur filter window
Getter appropriately reads GIMP's action-history file which persistently records user actions
Metric logic correctly checks for the presence of 'filters-gaussian-blur' action in the history
Expected value 'filters-gaussian-blur' is semantically correct - this is the exact action name GIMP records when the Gaussian Blur filter is opened
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP after task completion, which does not affect verification since action-history is a persistent file
State accessibility is guaranteed - the action-history file persists after GIMP closes and can be read by the getter
Complete coverage - the instruction only requires displaying/opening the filter window, which is fully verified by checking the action history
